verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official CLI (firebase-tools) that deploys code and assets, works with database data, and imports/exports Auth users. `login:ci` produces a token for non-interactive scripts, and the official MCP server lets an agent create and manage projects and Auth users. Security Rules are documented, but the pack never explicitly shows rules being deployed from the CLI, and schema generation appears only as a Gemini-in-console feature. missing for 10: explicit CLI deployment of Security Rules/policies, headless configuration of auth providers (not just user import/export), CLI-driven schema provisioning, independent hands-on evidence of an end-to-end scripted backend setup.
